# Jonas Falkenberg

Senior Data Engineer

# Profile

Data engineer with over six years of hands-on experience
building batch and streaming pipelines in Python and SQL.
I enjoy untangling messy legacy data flows, keeping cloud
costs predictable, and helping analytics teams work with
reliable, well-tested datasets.

# Work Experience

05/2023 – present
Senior Data Engineer at NexaGrid Analytics GmbH, Nordhafen
Part of the core platform team (5 engineers) handling smart
meter telemetry and billing data for utility clients.
- Rebuilt the nightly ingestion jobs in Apache Airflow and
  dbt on Snowflake, cutting warehouse compute spend by 28%.
- Set up Kafka Connect and PySpark streaming jobs on AWS EMR
  to process grid load readings every 15 minutes.
- Introduced automated data quality checks with Great
  Expectations before finance reports are refreshed.

08/2020 – 04/2023
Data Engineer at Blue Harbor Commerce AG, Althausen
Worked with marketing and logistics teams on the central
e-commerce data warehouse.
- Migrated over 40 fragile cron scripts to scheduled Airflow
  DAGs running on AWS ECS.
- Modeled order, return, and shipment tables in PostgreSQL
  and Amazon Redshift for Looker dashboards.
- Built Python connectors for carrier APIs and ERP exports.

 09/2018 – 07/2020
Junior BI & Data Developer at Vektor Softwerk GmbH, Althausen
First full-time role after university, supporting internal
reporting for mid-sized manufacturing clients.
- Wrote complex SQL queries, views, and stored procedures
  in PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
- Automated weekly CSV and Excel data imports using Python
  and pandas, replacing manual copy-paste steps.
- Assisted senior engineers with basic Linux server upkeep
  and database backup verification.

Althausen University of Applied Sciences (Final grade: 1.9)

using Python (08/2018).

08/2006 – 06/2014

Lessing-Gymnasium, Brückenfeld

- SnowPro Core Certification, Snowflake (02/2024)
- AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty (09/2022)
- Training: Apache Kafka for Data Engineers (3 days, 11/2021)

Nordhafen, 16 November 2026
